title: Coordinate correction probability bound
statement: For every sign-valued function on $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, every coordinate $i$, and every Boolean value $b$, the probability that the local correction in coordinate $i$ agrees with the sign encoded by $b$, when its input is chosen uniformly from $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, is at most $1$.
